note: Square crops cut from the original painting; each shows one material or detail only, never the building as a whole or its outline. Only opaque pixels are read (alpha >= 200 over every rectangle); the orange glow of the source is at alpha 0 and is not in any crop. Crops are enlarged by an integer factor with nearest neighbour so each is 240 to 348 px; source_rect_px is the rectangle in the original and native_px its size there.

crops.description: Brick wall: a brick pier on the hall front wall, the lit face and the dark side face, courses and mortar, no stone, no window.
Slate roof: the front roof slope between the eaves and the ridge, slate courses with the lighter slabs, no dormer, no edge.
Arched window of the long wall: green frame, glazing bars, dark glass, the arch ring and a little brick beside it.
Stone quoin: cream ashlar blocks of the chimney base (the same stone as the corner quoins, coping and sills).
Chimney brick: the shaft, lit face and dark face, finer and darker brick than the wall.
Generator and annex metal: green painted sheet-metal housing and drum with the fan grille, dark pipe at the edge.
